finalText:
**Redis went away and took everything with it.** One note: the log is dated `2026-07-04`, not last night.

| Time (UTC) | What happened |
|---|---|
| 02:00:00–02:14:03 | Healthy. All `200`s, cache hit ratio `0.90`–`0.98`. |
| 02:14:07.113 | `ERROR [api] redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:07.114 | Cache turned off, every read went straight to the store. |
| 02:14:10 onward | Store buckled. 173 × `TimeoutError ... after 5000ms`. |
| 02:29:12 | Queue depth passed its own limit, `502 (max 500)`. |
| 02:31:44.902 | `ERROR [worker-2] JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)` |
| 02:31:52.318 | `FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

Redis refused all 14 reconnects, spaced a flat 80 seconds apart, never backing off. No request succeeded after 02:14:03. Death took 17 minutes 45 seconds.

Two things to fix: cap the queue so it sheds load instead of eating memory, and find why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections.
